candidate.answerReason: Parallel lines and the angle bisector give equal angles BAE and AEB. Their opposite sides are equal, so BE=AB=5 and EC=8-5=3.

methods.label: Find an isosceles triangle
methods.explanation: Since \(AD\parallel BC\), \(\angle DAE=\angle AEB\). Also, \(\angle BAE=\angle DAE\), so \(\angle BAE=\angle AEB\). Thus, \(BE=AB=5\), and \(EC=8-5=3\).
methods.levelReason: Combines Grade 7 parallel-line and angle-bisector facts with the Grade 8 equal-angles imply equal-sides criterion.
